name: Smart Cart for WooCommerce – Side Cart Drawer & Free Shipping Bar
author: wowDevs

sections.description:
Smart Cart for WooCommerce turns the default cart page into a fast slide-out side cart (cart drawer). Shoppers add products, change quantities, apply coupons and estimate shipping without leaving the page, so fewer carts are abandoned.

Its rewards bar works like a free shipping progress bar, with one difference: when a shopper reaches a goal, Smart Cart applies the reward to the cart automatically. Free shipping unlocks, the discount lands and the free gift is added. Most cart plugins only show the bar.

Why use a WooCommerce side cart?

About 7 in 10 online carts never reach checkout. The usual “add to cart → page reload → cart page” detour sends shoppers away from what they were browsing. A side cart keeps them on the page, shows what’s left to unlock a reward and suggests one more product. That raises average order value (AOV) and conversion.

Slide-out cart drawer

  • AJAX add to cart on product pages, with no page reload. Works with simple and variable products.
  • Opens from the left or right, with a smooth animation and a backdrop. Full height on phones, built for thumbs.
  • Edit the cart in place: change quantities, remove items, apply and remove coupons.
  • Shipping estimate: shoppers enter country and postcode and see the shipping cost before checkout.
  • Floating cart button with a live item count and an optional subtotal.
  • Your theme’s cart icon opens the drawer. Links to the cart page open Smart Cart instead of a new page.
  • Cart icon in any menu location, or anywhere with the [smart_cart_button] shortcode (works in the Elementor Shortcode widget and block themes).

Rewards bar: free shipping, discounts and free gifts

Set up to 3 reward tiers, each with an optional start and end date:

  • Free shipping bar: uses your WooCommerce Free Shipping minimum, or your own amount (Smart Cart adds the free rate at checkout).
  • Percentage or fixed discount, applied as a cart discount line.
  • Free gift product, added at no cost when the goal is reached and removed if the cart drops below it.

The goal is counted on the item subtotal after coupons, including tax when your store shows prices with tax.

One-click upsells and cross-sells in the cart

Show cross-sells, related products or best sellers inside the drawer. Shoppers add them with one click, without leaving the cart.

Design it in minutes, with a live preview

  • 16 one-click color themes, plus your own colors, corner radius and drawer width.
  • Live preview built from your real store: real templates, real products and the real rewards engine, so what you see is what shoppers get.
  • Every text is editable. Translation ready, with WPML and Polylang support, and RTL ready.

Fast, light and theme proof

  • Lightweight: one ~12 KB script (about 4 KB gzipped) and one cached stylesheet. No icon fonts, no extra libraries, no extra requests on page load.
  • Works with any theme and page builder. All styles are scoped to the drawer, so Elementor kits and theme button styles can’t restyle it, and it can’t leak styles into your site.
  • Works with page caching. The drawer updates through WooCommerce cart fragments, and its security tokens refresh automatically on cached pages.
  • Accessible: real dialog semantics, focus trap, Escape to close, keyboard-friendly controls and reduced-motion support.
  • Pure WooCommerce: uses WooCommerce’s own cart, coupons, shipping and fees. Compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) and the Cart & Checkout blocks.

Smart Cart Pro

Everything above is free, complete and unlimited. Smart Cart Pro is a separate add-on with extra modules:

  • Upsell rules: pick what to suggest per category (phones get cases, shoes get socks).
  • Save for later: move cart items to a saved list and back.
  • Sticky add-to-cart bar on product pages.

Nothing in this plugin is locked or limited without it.

Privacy

Smart Cart stores no shopper data of its own beyond WooCommerce’s cart and session.

After you install it, an admin notice asks whether you want to share usage data with wowDevs to help improve the plugin. Nothing is sent unless you click “Allow & Continue”. If you do, Smart Cart sends to dashboard.wowdevs.com: your site URL and name, admin email and name, WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, locale, memory limits, the active theme and the list of installed plugins. You can ignore or dismiss the notice. A separate notice may ask for a review on WordPress.org; it sends nothing.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Smart Cart from Plugins → Add New (search for “Smart Cart”), or upload the zip, then activate it.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Smart Cart to set up the drawer, rewards and colors. It works with sensible defaults right away.
sections.faq:
How do I add a side cart to WooCommerce?

Install and activate Smart Cart. The slide-out cart works right away: products are added with AJAX and the drawer opens. Fine-tune it under WooCommerce → Smart Cart.

How do I add a free shipping progress bar?

Turn on the rewards bar under WooCommerce → Smart Cart → Rewards and add a free shipping tier. Use your WooCommerce Free Shipping minimum or set your own amount.

Does the free shipping reward really make shipping free?

Yes. The “custom amount” tier adds a free shipping rate at checkout once the goal is reached. The “WooCommerce minimum” tier reads the minimum from your existing Free Shipping method, and WooCommerce applies it.

Can I give a free gift when the cart reaches an amount?

Yes. Add a free gift tier and pick the product. It is added at no cost when the goal is reached and removed if the cart drops below it.

How is the reward goal calculated?

On the cart’s item subtotal after coupons, including tax when your store shows prices with tax. Shipping and other fees don’t count.

Can I schedule a reward for a sale?

Yes. Each tier has an optional start and end date, in your site’s timezone.

Can I put the cart icon in my header?

Yes. Pick a menu location under General → Cart icon in your menu or header, or use the [smart_cart_button] shortcode. Optional attributes: show_total="yes" and label="Cart".

My theme already has a mini cart. Will it conflict?

No. With “Open the drawer from your theme’s cart links” turned on, your theme’s cart icon opens Smart Cart instead.

Does it work with Elementor and block themes?

Yes. The drawer is printed in the footer with every theme. In Elementor, use the Shortcode widget for an inline cart icon. In block themes, use a Shortcode block.

Does it work with the WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. Smart Cart declares compatibility with the Cart & Checkout blocks and with HPOS.

Will it slow my site down?

No. The script is about 12 KB (about 4 KB gzipped), the stylesheet is cached, and nothing runs on pages where the drawer is turned off.

Does it work with page caching plugins?

Yes. Cart contents load through WooCommerce cart fragments, and expired security tokens refresh automatically on cached pages.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. Every text can be changed in the settings or translated with a .po file, WPML or Polylang. RTL languages are supported.

What’s the difference between Smart Cart and Smart Cart Pro?

Smart Cart is a complete cart drawer with rewards, upsells, coupons and shipping estimate, free and unlimited. Smart Cart Pro is an add-on with whole new modules (upsell rules, save for later, sticky add-to-cart bar). It never unlocks parts of a free feature.

Is there a filter to hide the drawer on some pages?

Yes. Use add_filter( 'smart_cart/should_render', '__return_false' ); with your own conditions.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0 [17th November 2026]

  • New: rewards bar with up to 3 tiers (free shipping, percentage or fixed discount, free gift), applied to the cart automatically, with optional start and end dates.
  • New: one-click upsells in the drawer (cross-sells, related products or best sellers).
  • New: shipping estimate inside the drawer.
  • New: 16 color themes and a live preview built from your real store.
  • New: every text is editable; WPML and Polylang support.
  • New: cart icon in any menu location and the [smart_cart_button] shortcode.
  • New: hooks for add-ons such as Smart Cart Pro.
  • Improved: works with page caching (security tokens refresh automatically).
  • Improved: styles scoped to the drawer, so themes and page builders can’t restyle it.
  • Improved: HPOS, Cart & Checkout blocks and RTL support.
  • Fix: restored cart totals are recalculated before the drawer is printed.

1.0.0 [23rd May 2025]

  • Initial release.

Full history: see changelog.txt.
